newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-CELTIC CONFIRM SALE OF VAN HOOYDONK TO FOREST.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CELTIC CONFIRM SALE OF VAN HOOYDONK TO FOREST.

text.p: Glasgow Celtic confirmed on Monday they had sold Dutch striker Pierre van Hooydonk to struggling English premier league side Nottingham Forest.

The Scottish giants said the deal was worth 3.0 million pounds to them, possibly rising to 4.5 million pounds depending on whether Forest avoid relegation this season and on Van Hooydonk's strike rate in the coming seasons.
Forest have been on the look out for a goalscorer to help them pull clear of the relegation zone. They have scored just one goal in their last seven matches and are 17th in the 20-team lead.
The club was the subject of a successful takeover bid two weeks ago which freed up around 16 million pounds ($26 million) for new players.

Van Hooydonk, Celtic's top scorer last season with 26 goals, had been unsettled at Parkhead this season despite scoring 16 times. He had lost his regular first team place to Portugal's Jorge Cadete, Celtic's current top scorer with 28.
He could make his debut for Forest against Blackburn Rovers in a league match on Tuesday night.
